market_summary: Roligt marked uden akutte makro-katalysatorer; fokus er porteføljepleje. Rockwool er naaet praktisk talt helt op til sit target og er maksimalt overkoebt uden fundamental bekraeftelse, saa gevinsten (+16.5%) tages hjem. Til gengaeld aabnes en ny position i DSV, der er dybt oversolgt efter Zacks' 'Bear of the Day'-stempel, selvom Q2-regnskabet reelt viste rekord-EBIT og opjusteret guidance.

decisions.name: Royal Unibrew
decisions.reasoning: Staerk indtjeningsvaekst (+40% YoY) og positivt momentum fortsaetter taet paa target 502, men kursen har endnu ikke bekraeftet sig over SMA200. Fastholder position og stop uaendret frem mod Q-regnskabet 17/8.
bull: Earnings growth of +40% YoY is very strong
Price is up 9.2% above its 50-day moving average with positive momentum
Ongoing share buyback programme plus a share capital reduction both signal shareholder-friendly capital allocation
Forward PE of 12.8x is reasonable given the earnings growth
bear: Price remains 3.2% below its 200-day moving average, so the longer-term trend hasn't fully turned
Momentum divergence is slightly negative (-2.69), suggesting the recent rally could be losing steam

investment_plan.thesis: Vaerdi/vaekst-kombination, men rallyet er endnu ikke bekraeftet teknisk (under SMA200). Stop fastholdes ved 470 for at beskytte gevinsten frem mod Q-regnskabet.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 470. Tag profit naer SMA200 (502). Reducer ved Q-rapport med omsaetningsskuffelse (2026-08-17).

decisions.name: ISS
decisions.reasoning: Flad organisk vaekst og svagt 5-dages momentum, men langsigtet uptrend intakt og aktien er kortsigtet oversolgt (stoch 8.5). Afventer Q-regnskab 11/8 foer ny vurdering.
bull: Price remains above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages, keeping the longer-term uptrend intact
Stochastic at 8.5 is technically oversold on a short-term basis, hinting at a bounce
Valuation at 12.7x forward PE is reasonable
Ongoing share buyback programme continues
bear: Revenue and earnings growth are both essentially flat YoY, showing little operating momentum
5-day momentum is negative at -4.5%, reflecting recent weakness
Analyst opinion is split on whether the stock is over- or undervalued

investment_plan.thesis: Sjaelden trifecta af positive katalysatorer, men flad organisk vaekst og et muligt distributionssignal begraenser opsiden herfra.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 265. Tag profit naer 320. Revurder ved skuffende Capital Markets Day-opfoelgning eller vedvarende flad omsaetningsvaekst, saerligt omkring Q-regnskabet 11/8.

decisions.name: Coloplast B
decisions.reasoning: Attraktivt udbytte (5.3%) og forbedret kortsigtet momentum, men kursen ligger stadig 9.4% under SMA200 og value-casen afhaenger af en indtjeningsbedring der endnu ikke er materialiseret. Naer target, saa den haevede stop fastholdes for at beskytte gevinsten.
bull: 5.3% dividend yield offers an attractive income cushion
Price has recovered to 8% above its 50-day moving average, showing short-term momentum improvement
Cited by a value investor as an attractively priced global stock with a high yield
bear: Price remains 9.4% below its 200-day moving average, indicating the longer-term downtrend is not yet reversed
Trailing PE of 45.8x is elevated relative to the much lower 16.3x forward multiple, so the value case depends on an earnings recovery that hasn't materialized yet
Revenue growth is muted at just +2.2% YoY

investment_plan.thesis: Deep-value sundhedsnavn med et frisk regulatorisk katalysator (FDA-godkendelse) og velbegrundet udbytte. Naer target, saa stop fastholdes haevet for at beskytte gevinsten.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 405. Tag profit naer 450. Revurder hvis SMA200-afstanden fortsat udvides uden fundamental bedring.

decisions.name: Rockwool B
decisions.reasoning: Kursen er naaet praktisk talt helt op til target (222.4 vs. 225) efter en kraftig rally, og stokastikken er maksimalt overkoebt (100) mens trailing-indtjeningen forbliver negligibel og omsaetningsvaeksten flad. Tager gevinsten (+16.5%) hjem forud for Q2-regnskabet 19/8 frem for at haabe paa yderligere opside uden fundamental bekraeftelse.
bull: Very strong momentum, +10.1% over 5 days, breaking well above both moving averages
Analysts recently raised their fair-value estimate to DKK 231, close to the current price
Forward PE of 14.9x looks reasonable if earnings normalize
bear: Stochastic at 100 signals the stock is technically overbought and extended
Trailing PE is effectively infinite, indicating negligible or negative recent reported earnings
Revenue growth is flat at 0% YoY

investment_plan.thesis: Positionen lukkes efter at target praktisk talt er naaet og teknikken er blevet ekstremt overkoebt uden fundamental bekraeftelse. Gevinsten (+16.5%) fastholdes fremfor at risikere en give-back foran regnskabet.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Position lukket i dag — ingen videre eksponering.

decisions.name: Danske Bank
decisions.reasoning: Opjusteret 2026-guidance, staerk indtjeningsvaekst (+15.2% YoY) og en bekraeftet uptrend understoettet af loebende buybacks. Aktien er overkoebt naer 52-ugers-hoejeste, men den fundamentale historie er fortsat intakt, saa positionen fastholdes uaendret for at undgaa yderligere koncentration i Financial Services.
bull: Management raised 2026 net profit guidance to DKK 23-25bn alongside a 14% ROE target
Earnings growth of +15.2% YoY is strong and accelerating
Price is in a firm uptrend, +22.9% above its 200-day moving average and near its 52-week high
Ongoing weekly share buybacks continue to return capital to shareholders
bear: Stochastic at 93.5 signals the stock is overbought and near-term extended
Trading right at its 52-week high leaves little margin of safety if sentiment shifts

investment_plan.thesis: Danske Bank leverede staerke H1-resultater med opjusteret helaarsguidance, understoettet af en sund uptrend. Fastholdes uaendret for at undgaa yderligere koncentration i Financial Services-sektoren.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 350. Tag profit naer 400. Revurder ved guidance-nedjustering eller brud i kreditkvaliteten.

decisions.name: Vestas Wind Systems
decisions.reasoning: Indtjenings- og omsaetningsvaekst peger paa en reel turnaround, men kursen ligger taet paa stop-loss lige foran Q-regnskabet 12/8. Overvaages taet, men ingen aktion foer regnskabet eller et brud under 163.
bull: Revenue growth of +14.4% YoY and strong reported earnings growth reflect a business turnaround
Positioned as a beneficiary of AI-driven power demand and energy-security tailwinds per recent coverage
Ongoing share buyback programme continues
Price is holding just above its 200-day moving average (+1.3%), preserving the longer-term trend
bear: Price is 2.6% below its 50-day moving average, showing near-term technical softness
Dividend yield is low at just 0.42%
20-day momentum is negative at -4.4%

investment_plan.thesis: Tidlig fundamental turnaround: eksplosiv indtjeningsvaekst signalerer at ordreindtag og marginer er ved at vende. Teknisk endnu ikke bekraeftet og handler taet paa stop-loss foran Q-regnskabet — overvaages dagligt.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 163 (taet paa nuvaerende pris - overvaag dagligt). Tag profit naer 205. Revurder hvis indtjeningsvaeksten viser sig enkeltstaaende, eller hvis prisen ikke genobre SMA50 inden kvartalsrapport 2026-08-12.

decisions.name: Sydbank
decisions.reasoning: Staerkt momentum og eksceptionel omsaetningsvaekst (+65% YoY), men indtjeningen er stadig presset (-26.8% YoY) og aktien er overkoebt. Fastholder uaendret frem mod regnskabet 26/8.
bull: Price is pressing its 52-week high with strong momentum (+5.3% over 5 days, +5.9% over 20 days)
Revenue growth of +65% YoY is exceptionally strong
Ongoing weekly share buybacks signal management confidence in valuation
Forward PE of 10.5x remains a modest discount to the Financial Services sector norm (12x)
bear: RSI (67) and stochastic (100) are overbought, raising the risk of a near-term pullback
Earnings growth is down -26.8% YoY despite the strong revenue growth, pointing to margin pressure

investment_plan.thesis: Kombination af billig vaerdiansaettelse og staerkt momentum, men marginpres (indtjening -26.8% YoY trods omsaetningsvaekst) er en reel risiko der skal afklares ved naeste regnskab.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 600. Tag profit naer 680. Revurder hvis marginpresset forvaerres yderligere uden stabilisering, eller ved svag kvartalsrapport 2026-08-26.

decisions.name: Novo Nordisk B
decisions.reasoning: Q2-regnskabet bekraeftede thesis med opjusteret guidance trods Wegovy-miss, og aktien er nu dybt oversolgt (RSI 30.8) til en 45% rabat til sektoren. Positionen udgoer allerede 29.5% af porteføljen efter gaarsdagens udbygning, saa der koebes ikke mere — fastholdes uaendret og overvaages for koncentrationsrisiko.
bull: RSI (31) and stochastic (16) are in oversold territory, supporting a near-term bounce
Forward PE of 13.7x is a ~45% discount to the Healthcare sector norm (25x)
5.2% dividend yield provides a valuation cushion
Despite the Wegovy miss, full-year guidance was raised, showing management confidence
bear: Wegovy sales missed expectations and a trial setback overshadowed the raised outlook
Earnings growth is down 20.5% YoY
5-day momentum is sharply negative at -12.25%, reflecting continued selling pressure

investment_plan.thesis: Deep-value-position i en kvalitets-GLP-1-leder efter et bekraeftet Q2-regnskab med guidance-oploeftning. Positionen er nu fuldt udbygget til 29.5% af porteføljen — ingen yderligere tilkoeb, kun overvaagning af koncentrationsrisiko.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 285. Tag profit naer 345. Revurder efter Eli Lillys regnskab og ved nye pipeline-skuffelser eller accelereret GLP-1-markedsandelstab til Lilly.

decisions.name: DSV
decisions.reasoning: Dybt oversolgt (RSI 14.9, stoch 4.3) trods et Q2-regnskab med rekord-EBIT og opjusteret guidance i Schenker-integrationen — Zacks' 'Bear of the Day'-stempel afspejler sentiment, ikke fundamentals. Forward PE 15.8x er taet paa sektornormen, og momentum-divergensen (+14.1pp) tyder paa at udsalget er ved at aftage. Sizet til det tilgaengelige koebsbudget (min. 2.500 kr. kontant-reserve bevaret).
bull: RSI (15) and stochastic (4) are deeply oversold, a classic bounce setup
Forward PE of 15.8x is close to the Industrials sector norm (18x) despite a 44x trailing multiple
Q2 earnings showed record EBIT and upgraded guidance amid Schenker integration progress
Momentum divergence (+14.1pp) suggests the 5-day decline is decelerating versus the 20-day trend
bear: Zacks flagged DSV as its 'Bear of the Day', citing a weakened near-term investment case
Price is 14.6% below its 50-day and 14.9% below its 200-day moving average, confirming a firm downtrend
Volume is running at 3.7x average, showing heavy institutional selling alongside the drop

investment_plan.thesis: Kontrarisk indgang i en kvalitetslogistikaktoer efter et fundamentalt staerkt Q2-regnskab (rekord-EBIT, opjusteret guidance) blev overskygget af negativ sentiment og tung institutionel salgsvolumen. Ekstrem oversolgt teknik plus rimelig forward-vaerdiansaettelse giver et attraktivt risk/reward for en mean-reversion.
investment_plan.exit_conditions: Saelg ved brud under 1212 (2x ATR stop). Tag profit naer 1550 (SMA50-genobring). Revurder hvis den institutionelle salgsvolumen fortsaetter uden stabilisering, eller ved svaghed i naeste regnskab (2026-10-21).
